boundaries.name: rustc-module-resolution
boundaries.obligation: rustc path/module resolution, #[path] overrides, feature and cfg evaluation and edition rules are not modeled; the item lists are a handwritten transcription of the mod.rs lines.

boundaries.name: filesystem-snapshot
boundaries.obligation: leafFiles is an ls snapshot of the working tree on 2026-09-07; renamed, added or deleted .rs files are not detected by the model.

boundaries.name: out-of-scope-witness-and-root
boundaries.obligation: src/circuits/witness/mod.rs and src/lib.rs (root pub mod circuits;) are not modeled; the visibility of the pub use targets inside witness and the root declaration are premises.

boundaries.name: declaration-level-only
boundaries.obligation: Nothing about the contents, gates or semantics of any declared leaf module is covered; reachability and test-gating are declaration-level facts only.
